command:
tries=0
until pg_isready -h smelt-db.smelt-park.svc.cluster.local -U postgres; do
  tries=$((tries + 1))
  if [ "$tries" -gt 40 ]; then
    echo "the database never answered" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 3
done
init_container.name: database-is-ready
